title: Combining Global and Local Attention with Positional Encoding for Video Summarization
encoders: GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D; no audio or text branch
sampling: 2-fps feature package; exact picks retained in HDF5
architecture: Global/local multi-head attention with positional encoding and score regressor
fusion: Global and local branch combination; default add in released configuration
objective: Supervised importance regression; exact objective in primary paper Section III and model/solver.py
split: Five released random 80/20 splits; not disjoint five-fold CV
postprocessing: Score expansion, mean shot values, released KTS boundaries and knapsack; max SumMe / mean TVSum
code_status: Official; authors and paper linked in README
weights: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5635735; advertised author checkpoint archive, not executed
features: Author-repackaged HDF5 .rar archives in repository data/
reproducibility: Source inspected; upstream environment and checkpoints not run
limitations: Legacy dependencies and hard-coded evaluation paths; do not conflate test evaluation each epoch with a held-out validation protocol.

title: DSNet: A Flexible Detect-to-Summarize Network for Video Summarization
sampling: Released picks; custom extraction README uses --sample-rate 15 (frame stride, not 15 fps)
architecture: Anchor-based and anchor-free importance and interval heads
fusion: Visual temporal features; no audio/text fusion
objective: Supervised interest classification and interval localization; variant-specific objective in TIP method sections
training_data: SumMe, TVSum; OVP/YouTube in augmented/transfer regimes
split: Author YAML split files; canonical, augmented and transfer kept separate
postprocessing: Proposal decoding, NMS; released summary conversion and budget routine
code_status: Official; Jiahao Li and paper backlink
weights: Author-linked pretrain_ab_basic.zip and pretrain_af_basic.zip on Dropbox; download/reproduction not verified
features: Author-linked dsnet_datasets.zip and alternative mirrors; HDF5 plus change points
reproducibility: README and selected source inspected; no environment rebuild or model execution
limitations: NMS settings and custom frame stride change outputs; repository BibTeX says 2020 while volume publication is 2021.

title: CSTA: CNN-based Spatiotemporal Attention for Video Summarization
encoders: GoogLeNet frame features; inspect backbone variants in primary paper
sampling: Standard pre-extracted feature timeline; full-frame expansion corrected in author repository
architecture: 2D CNN over frame-feature matrices for spatiotemporal attention
fusion: Visual feature and attention paths; no required audio/text branch
objective: Supervised frame-importance regression; primary paper method section
framework: PyTorch; version-specific dependency audit not completed
reproducibility: Paper/source release verified; no model execution
limitations: Record evaluation-code revision: downsampled-only versus full-timeline summary generation changes the reported protocol.

title: Learning to Summarize Videos by Contrasting Clips
architecture: Selects and contrasts top-k features rather than a whole-video mean
objective: Contrastive objective over selected clips; differentiable top-k in primary method section, optional labeled personalization evaluated separately
reproducibility: Primary paper identity and method verified; code/environment not independently audited
limitations: Optional personal labels must not be mixed into unsupervised comparison. Few-shot tag refers to the labeled personalization variant. No publication venue beyond arXiv verified.

title: SELF-VS: Self-supervised Encoding Learning For Video Summarization
encoders: CNN video-classification teacher and Transformer student; upstream teacher supervision must be recorded
architecture: Importance-weighted semantic representation matching for pretraining; downstream summarization stage separate
objective: Self-supervised representation distillation followed by downstream fine-tuning; primary paper Sections 3 and 4
reproducibility: Primary paper inspected; no code or weights execution
limitations: Self-supervised encoder pretraining is not evidence of label-free downstream selection; checkpoint and downstream-label usage need an implementation audit.
